claim: The Windows v1.014 build contains 11 28-byte signed swing/accuracy profiles centered on zero, used to convert even signed accuracy-error offsets into swing-adjuster values.

sources.observation: Profile extraction from VA 0x41F204 yields 11 rows of 14 signed 16-bit samples with symmetric or near-symmetric negative/zero/positive swing values.

notes: Exact club/profile selection and any additional continuous curvature remain to be proven.
